propositions: When rebar emits a parent change for a non-epic parent, _resolve_local_parent returns (False, None) — byte-identical to 'unbound parent, retry later' — causing the field to be omitted from the update and dispatch_one._update_one_apply_parent to never run, making bridge_alerts structurally unreachable and the hierarchy divergence invisible to operators.

Datacenter silently accepts PUT requests to fields.parent on a subtask but ignores them without changing the parent; clearing a subtask parent with {parent: null} returns 400 and subtask editmeta exposes no parent field, making subtask reparent unrepresentable on DC.

Two test cells asserting subtask reparent round-trips were wrong oracles for an operation the platform cannot perform; they must be re-homed to assert the supported mechanism (Epic Link on non-subtask children) and the user-visible outcome that divergences are reported loudly rather than silently dropped.

The emit-time suppression of non-epic parents must record divergences durably to the existing dropped_field_sink and produce outbound-field-dropped bridge alerts, preserving the 8b25 guard's omission behavior while making operator-invisible divergences visible.

Three test cells that never passed in 12 consecutive runs (30834117797 through 30951453979) must be resolved by re-homing to the supported Epic Link mechanism while preserving their subject assertions and without deletion, skipping, or xfail.
